column1: # Sana evaluation set -- separate from models-eval.tsv on purpose.
# These weights are useless without INSTALL_EXTRA_MODELS=1, because ComfyUI has
# no native Sana nodes. Keeping them in their own manifest means turning Sana off
# actually skips the ~9.7 GB rather than downloading it and never loading it.
# Format: <target path under /models>
# Apache 2.0 for the transformer, and by far the smallest candidate. Its text
# encoder is Gemma-2-2b-it under the Gemma licence, which this project is
# already subject to because the LLM tier is Gemma 4.
# REQUIRES INSTALL_EXTRA_MODELS=1. ComfyUI 0.34.2 on this box exposes no Sana
# nodes at all -- verified against /object_info, not assumed -- so Sana needs
# city96/ComfyUI_ExtraModels, a third-party pack running inside the ComfyUI
# process. That is a supply-chain decision, which is why it is opt-in.
# Sana is trained for general photoreal and text rendering rather than anime, so
# expect it to lose on style. It is in the mix because the age-legibility test is
# style-agnostic and a 3.2 GB model that passes it would change the 12 GB budget
# completely.
sana/transformer.safetensors
sana/vae.safetensors
text_encoders/gemma-2-2b-it.safetensors
